_about: The one source of colour, size and motion for Adaptive Desktop. scripts/build-tokens.py turns it
into every stylesheet (shell, GTK theme, Files, Home, Agent Office, the TV page, the GTK apps);
scripts/build-tokens.py --check fails when a colour is written by hand anywhere else.
Three tiers. ramp + hue are the raw material. alpha is the only set of strengths a colour may
be used at. color is what stylesheets name: a role that points at a ramp step or a hue.
In a *.src.css file write $role or $role/NN (NN from alpha), for example $text.primary, $white/8.

ramp._about: Twelve neutrals n0..n11 from one hue: OKLCH, constant hue and chroma, these lightness steps.

color._about: Depth is lightness: each surface level is one ramp step lighter than the one it sits on.

_about: The terminal's sixteen ANSI colours and its ground. Programs need six distinct hues, so yellow
and purple exist here and nowhere else in the interface. scripts/install-terminal.py applies
this to the Terminator profile, the prompt, the shell's menus and the editor's terminal.

gradient._about: The only gradient: Mario thinking or answering. Never decoration.

exempt._about: Files whose colours are artwork or data, not interface. Everything else must use tokens.
exempt.scripts/build-file-icons.py: icon artwork: the folder and file-type illustrations
exempt.scripts/install-terminal.py: the Catppuccin values KTERM ships with, listed so they can be replaced by tokens
exempt.terminal/install-kterm-ubuntu.sh: KTERM's own installer, kept as released; install-terminal.py recolours what it writes
exempt.terminal/install-kterm-raspberry-pi.sh: KTERM's own installer, kept as released
exempt.extension/adaptive_files/tags.py: file tag colours: labels the user picks, stored with the file
exempt.apps/adaptive-annotate/shapes.py: pen colours the user draws with
